run_env_list: run the script to list all registered MiniHack environment IDs excluding custom ones
run_main: run the main function to print all MiniHack gymnasium environment names to stdout
review_skip_envs_list: review the skip_envs_list variable to see which MiniHack environments are excluded from listing
review_main: review the main function that filters and prints MiniHack environment specs from the gymnasium registry
refactor_main: refactor the main function to filter MiniHack environments by a custom prefix or exclusion list
